name: s4-after-hours-callback
description: S4. Mrs. Alder calls as in S2, grades Restless and picks Old Town, but Old Town's hours are substituted with hours:closed (open one minute a week, Sunday 03:00 to 03:01 America/New_York; never run S4 in that minute, VERIFY.md HC1), so hh-district-old-town takes the after-hours branch, says the crew is off shift, and offers a callback. She presses 1, which invokes module:hh-offer-callback: UpdateContactCallbackNumber from her own number, then CreateCallbackContact in queue:dispatch-overflow. Neither the module invoke nor the create is an event the pinned flow-cli observes, so the offer prompt and the keypress are the last observations and the test ends there (endTest defaults to true). Whether EndTest at that point keeps a real callback from being created is VERIFY.md CB1; after every run, sweep dispatch-overflow for callback contacts and stop each one (scenarios/README.md, "After an S4 run"), because two leaked callbacks fill the queue's cap of 2 in dev and qa.
